description: This PHP class defines the 'Subscription' model within the OpenCart admin system. It provides methods to manage subscription data such as editing subscriptions, updating details like payment method, plan, remaining periods, and dates, as well as retrieving subscription information and counts based on various filters. The class also supports adding historical records related to subscription status changes.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Represents the Subscription model in the OpenCart admin system, handling CRUD operations and analytics for subscriptions.

methods.name: editSubscription
methods.description: Updates the subscription's plan ID and customer payment ID based on the given subscription ID.

methods.name: editPaymentMethod
methods.description: Updates the payment method associated with a subscription.

methods.name: editSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Changes the plan associated with a specific subscription.

methods.name: editRemaining
methods.description: Sets the remaining period count for a subscription.

methods.name: editTrialRemaining
methods.description: Sets the remaining trial period count for a subscription.

methods.name: editDateNext
methods.description: Updates the next scheduled date for a subscription.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionByCustomerPaymentId
methods.description: Deletes a subscription record based on the customer payment ID.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific subscription, decoding JSON-encoded options.

methods.name: getSubscriptionByOrderProductId
methods.description: Fetches a subscription linked to a specific order and product ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscriptions filtered and sorted according to supplied criteria.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns the total number of subscriptions matching specific filters.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionsByStoreId
methods.description: Counts subscriptions associated with a particular store ID.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionsBySubscriptionStatusId
methods.description: Counts subscriptions with a specific subscription status ID.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Logs a change of subscription status with optional comment and notification.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of historical status changes for a given subscription, including date, status, comment, and notification flag.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total count of history records for a subscription.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesBySubscriptionStatusId
methods.description: Returns the total count of history records with a specific subscription status ID.
